These findings suggest that the compound may act as a modulator or inhibitor of the transporter, potentially influencing its function in cellular processes. The evidence is consistent across multiple pathways, indicating a possible role in the regulation of anion transport, though the exact mechanism of interaction remains to be elucidated.
